scientific_integrity: The 56-vertex weighted-clique reduction and exhaustive standard-library verifier give a finite proof; separate branch-and-bound confirms the numeric optimum and equality count. Prior unrestricted code bounds and constructions are credited, not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite four-letter DNA alphabet only; no theorem for longer words, biochemical performance, GC restrictions, reverse-complement error detection, or historical priority certification.
title: A sharp reverse-complement closure penalty for four-letter non-overlapping DNA codes
